glossary.definition: (1) "Storage facility" means any place to which a for-hire motor carrier delivers a towed motor vehicle for storage.
glossary.source_title: Section 4513.70 - Civil action against towing service or storage facility by insurance company.

glossary.definition: (2) "Towing service" means any for-hire motor carrier that tows motor vehicles.
glossary.source_title: Section 4513.70 - Civil action against towing service or storage facility by insurance company.

title: Section 4513.70 - Civil action against towing service or storage facility by insurance company.
